item.description: Provider notes, progress notes, and clinical assessments
item.content:encoded:
Clinical Notes

This section contains detailed clinical notes from healthcare providers including progress notes, assessments, and clinical observations.

Note Types

Progress Notes

  • From oncology visits
  • From supportive care appointments
  • From specialist consultations
  • Structured format (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan - SOAP)

Hospital Notes

  • Admission notes
  • Discharge summaries
  • Nursing documentation
  • Daily progress notes during inpatient stays

Specialist Consultations

  • Specialty evaluations
  • Recommendations and management plans
  • Follow-up instructions

Procedure Notes

  • Pre-procedure evaluations
  • Procedural notes
  • Post-procedure instructions

Note Components

Clinical notes typically include:

  • Date and time of visit/evaluation
  • Provider name and credentials
  • Chief complaint or reason for visit
  • History of present illness — Detailed description of symptoms and course
  • Pertinent past medical history — Relevant background
  • Medications — Current medication list
  • Physical examination — Vital signs and organ system findings
  • Assessment — Clinical impression and problem list
  • Plan — Management and treatment recommendations
  • Follow-up — Next steps and scheduling

Lab Values in Notes

Clinical notes often reference recent laboratory values showing:

  • Trends since last visit
  • Response to treatment
  • Need for medication adjustments
  • Clinical correlation with symptoms

Individual clinical notes are organized chronologically by date of visit.
